title: Design System: iTala Connect
scope: Two scoped worlds that never mix. Event pages (a published event at /events/[eventId]): Painted Lines, organiser --ev-* tokens only; colour values are the default event theme. Platform screens (Home, Sign in, admin shell, 404 pages): Broadcast Package, --brand-* tokens (frontmatter keys prefixed platform-). Brand tokens never apply inside an event page; the only iTala element there is the "Powered by iTala Connect" footer, painted in event tokens.

ev-on-accent.note: Computed black or white by readableOn(accent); never hand-picked.

ev-muted.note: Also the "Powered by iTala Connect" footer.

platform-ground.note: Equals the ground of the iTala mark.

platform-teal.note: Also --brand-focus. Identity and plate edges only.

platform-lime.note: Only the LIVE pip and the one primary action on a screen.

divisionTokens.--div: Organiser-chosen division colour, set per element by divisionVars(); invalid values fall back to the default accent.
divisionTokens.--on-div: Computed black or white text for solid --div fills.

display.purpose: The event name, once per page. Uppercase, balanced.

score.purpose: Score numerals on a drawn court, sized by container query.

court-name.purpose: Court numbers only, like a floor stencil. Uppercase.

team-name.purpose: Team names in grid cells and stations.

label.purpose: Station terms such as Final and Up next. Uppercase.

platform-plate-title.purpose: Page h1 inside the lower-third title plate. Uppercase, balanced, font-stretch 78%.

platform-wordmark.purpose: "iTala" in the network bar; "Connect" in teal at 700, 75% width, 0.9375rem, uppercase.

platform-bug-name.purpose: Event names in rundown rows. Uppercase, font-stretch 85%.

platform-date.purpose: DD/MM in date blocks, year beneath at 0.75rem muted. Font-stretch 75%.

platform-strip.purpose: Teal tagline or subtitle on the strip beneath a title plate. Uppercase.

platform-label.purpose: Section labels (0.12em), field labels, table headers. Uppercase, muted.

platform-body.purpose: Reading text at normal width; ledes at most 62ch.

platform-meta.purpose: Divisions and date range under event names; small print. Muted.

strokes.name: line
strokes.purpose: All structural paint: court lines, outlines, over-paint, now line.

strokes.name: rule
strokes.purpose: Quiet separation: stations, grid hours, footer, final and awaiting cells.

strokes.name: emphasis
strokes.purpose: Chosen team's cells and underline on the court; focus outline.

strokes.name: over-paint
strokes.purpose: Active tab; final tick on grid cells.

strokes.name: baseline-tick
strokes.purpose: Final state closing both baselines of a drawn court.

strokes.name: dash
strokes.purpose: Up next on a drawn court.

motion.name: paint-in
motion.purpose: A changed score clips up from the floor.

motion.name: now-line
motion.purpose: The now line easing to its new position.

motion.name: platform-colour
motion.purpose: Platform: nav, button, row, date block and input colour changes.

motion.name: platform-wipe
motion.value: 420ms clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0), sub-strip delayed 120ms
motion.purpose: Platform signature: title plate wipes in once on load, left to right.

motion.name: platform-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Platform: wipe, pip and all transitions off.

platformShapes.name: plate-cut
platformShapes.purpose: One right-end diagonal on buttons, title plates, sub-strips, event bugs.

platformShapes.name: panel-cut
platformShapes.purpose: Bottom-right corner cut on the organiser plate, sign-in panel, placeholders.

platformShapes.name: key
platformShapes.value: 0.9rem wide, 0.45rem cut (0.6rem and 0.3rem as a heading key)
platformShapes.purpose: Teal key block ahead of a title plate or panel heading.

platformShapes.name: date-edge
platformShapes.purpose: Teal top edge of every date block.

platformShapes.name: seam
platformShapes.purpose: Network bar base, section label rules, status bug and notice outlines.

platformShapes.name: focus
platformShapes.value: outline: 3px solid var(--brand-focus); outline-offset: 2px (inside at -3px on clipped event bugs; inputs 2px at 0)

logo.origin: iTala mobile app favicon.png, copied unchanged 26/09/2026
logo.treatment: Place directly on Network Ground. Not transparent; do not doctor, recolour, crop or re-ground.

} .ds-live { width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--paint); } .ds-court { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 28 / 15; container-type: inline-size; } .ds-lines { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; fill: none; stroke: var(--paint); stroke-width: 2px; } .ds-lines * { vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; } .ds-floor { fill: var(--floor-tint); } .ds-key { fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--div) 34%, var(--ev-bg, #0D0D0D)); } .ds-dot { fill: var(--paint); stroke: none; } .ds-name { position: absolute; top: 8%; width: 45%; margin: 0; color: var(--ev-heading, #FFFFFF); font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(0.875rem, 4.3cqi, 1.3rem); line-height: 1.15; text-align: center; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-name.ds-l { left: 3%; } .ds-name.ds-r { right: 3%; } .ds-name span, .ds-score span { padding: 0 0.15em; background: var(--floor-tint); box-decoration-break: clone; } .ds-score { position: absolute; top: 38%; margin: 0; color: var(--ev-heading, #FFFFFF); font-family: 'Big Shoulders', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: min(15cqi, 5.5rem); line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-score.ds-l { left: 21%; right: 52%; text-align: center; } .ds-score.ds-r { left: 52%; right: 21%; text-align: center; }

components.css: .ds-cells { --paint: var(--ev-accent, #FFCC00); --bg: var(--ev-bg, #0D0D0D); --rule: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-muted, #888888) 38%, var(--bg)); display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 11rem); gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem; background: var(--bg); color: var(--ev-text, #E0E0E0); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-cell { position: relative; display: grid; align-content: start; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem 0.75rem; background: var(--bg); border: 2px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--paint) 55%, var(--bg)); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-cell[data-status='on-court'] { border-style: solid; border-color: var(--paint); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paint) 13%, var(--bg)); } .ds-cell[data-status='final'] { border: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-cell[data-status='final']::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -1px; bottom: -1px; width: 2.25rem; height: 4px; background: var(--paint); } .ds-cell-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-sw { width: 0.625rem; height: 0.625rem; background: #E06040; } .ds-tag { justify-self: start; padding: 0 0.375rem; background: var(--paint); color: var(--ev-on-accent, #000000); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-status { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-team { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-team b { color: var(--ev-heading, #FFFFFF); font-family: 'Big Shoulders', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-tabs { background: var(--ev-bg, #0D0D0D); padding: 1rem; } .ds-tabs ul { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; border-bottom: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-muted, #888888) 38%, var(--ev-bg, #0D0D0D)); } .ds-tabs a { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.875rem; margin-bottom: -2px; border-bottom: 4px solid transparent; color: var(--ev-muted, #888888); font-family: 'Big Shoulders', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.125rem; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-tabs li:first-child a { padding-left: 0; } .ds-tabs a:hover { color: var(--ev-text, #E0E0E0); } .ds-tabs a[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--ev-heading, #FFFFFF); border-bottom-color: var(--ev-accent, #FFCC00); } .ds-tabs a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ev-accent, #FFCC00); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem; background: var(--ev-bg, #0D0D0D); } .ds-chip { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.875rem; border: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--div) 70%, var(--ev-bg, #0D0D0D)); border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--ev-text, #E0E0E0); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-chip:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--div) 16%, var(--ev-bg, #0D0D0D)); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--div); border-color: var(--div); color: var(--on-div); font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ev-accent, #FFCC00); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Finder Toggle

narrative.northStar: Painted Lines (event pages) and Broadcast Package (platform screens)
narrative.overview:
iTala Connect has two scoped visual worlds. Each owns its routes, its tokens and its fonts, and the two never mix. Event pages (a published event at /events/[eventId]) are Painted Lines, painted in the organiser's --ev-* colours only. Platform screens (Home, Sign in, the admin shell and the 404 pages) are Broadcast Package, in --brand-* tokens.

The public event page is the organiser's gym floor. The organiser's background colour is the floor, and their accent colour is the line paint. Every structure on the page is a flat painted line at court weight (2 px), and each court is drawn as a real court (FIBA proportions, centre line, centre circle, keys filled with a division-colour tint) carrying its live game: team names on each half, big score numerals, the court number stencilled above it. Space separates sections, not boxes. There is no glow, no gradient, no shadow and no wood-grain costume.

Inside an event page every colour comes from the organiser's five event colours (--ev-accent, --ev-bg, --ev-text, --ev-muted, --ev-heading), the derived --ev-on-accent, and per-element division colours (--div, --on-div). The hex values in the frontmatter are the default event theme a new event starts with, not a brand palette. The only iTala element on an event page is the small "Powered by iTala Connect" footer.

The page is dense but calm: answer first (time, court, teams, score), readable at a glance in a bright gym on a mid-range phone, working from 360 px wide with 44 px touch targets. Copy is NZ English, dates DD/MM/YYYY, times "7:00 pm", in the event's time zone.

The platform is the iTala network's on-air graphics package. Home runs the season like a broadcast rundown, and admin is the production truck behind it. Every page opens with a lower-third title plate that wipes in once; events and admin rows are bug plates on a navy-black network ground, each cut on a single diagonal at its right end. Depth is three tonal steps of navy separated by hairline seams, never shadow, glow, gradient or glass. It deliberately is not a white-card SaaS dashboard with a left sidebar.

Colour is rationed. Teal is the network's identity: the key block ahead of each title plate, the top edge of every date block, the current nav underline, focus, and secondary actions. Lime is air time: it marks an event that is on now, with a pulsing pip, and the one primary action on a screen. Everything else is ink and muted ink on navy.
keyCharacteristics: Organiser colours only, applied as paint on the organiser's floor.
Constant 2 px paint lines; quiet 1 px rules for secondary separation.
State carried by stroke and by words: solid is on court, dashed is up next, a closed baseline tick is final.
Tall condensed athletic lettering (Big Shoulders) for numerals and headings, stencil cut for court numbers, Archivo for names and body.
One moving mark (the "now" line) plus a brief paint-in when a score changes.
Network ground platform-ground, plates on two navy steps, 1 px seams.
Angled plates with one diagonal cut on the right end; panels cut on the bottom-right corner; no rounded corners.
Teal is identity and plate edges; lime is only LIVE and the one primary action.
Saira throughout: condensed caps (width 75% to 85%) on plates, normal width for reading, tabular figures everywhere.
One signature motion (the title plate wipe) and one repeating motion (the LIVE pip).

rules.name: The Two Worlds Rule
rules.body: Brand tokens never apply inside an event page. The only iTala element on an event page is the small "Powered by iTala Connect" footer, and even that is painted in the event's own tokens (Muted Ink over a Quiet Rule), never in --brand-*. Event tokens never appear on a platform screen. When /events/[eventId] has no published event to show, the route renders the platform "Event not found" screen: there is no organiser palette to paint, so it is a platform screen, not an event page.

rules.name: The Organiser's Paint Rule
rules.body: Inside an event page every colour is an --ev-* token, a division token, or a color-mix of them. No hex literals, no Tailwind colour utilities, and no --brand-* token ever applies there.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Every state that has a colour also has words and a stroke pattern ("On court", "Final", "Awaiting score", "Up next"). A division is named next to its swatch. An organiser palette with poor contrast must still read.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every score, time and date uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so live changes never shift the layout.

rules.name: The Stencil Is For Courts Rule
rules.body: Big Shoulders Stencil marks court numbers only, like a floor stencil. It is never used for headings, scores or body.

rules.name: The Flat Paint Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, no glow, no gradient, no texture. If something needs emphasis, give it heavier paint or a tint, not a lift.

rules.name: The Floor Patch Rule
rules.body: Lettering that sits on a drawn court sits on a patch of Floor Tint, so painted lines never cross a name or a score.

rules.name: The Two Pixel Rule
rules.body: Paint is 2 px. Anything thicker is a deliberate state signal from the list above, never decoration.

rules.name: The Stroke Carries State Rule
rules.body: Solid paint is on court. Dashed paint (7 on, 5 off on the court; CSS dashed on cells) is up next. A closed baseline tick is final. Faded paint is a court that has finished or has no more games. Awaiting score is a quiet 1 px outline with no tick.

rules.name: The Teal Is Identity Rule
rules.body: Teal marks who is speaking: plate edges, keys, the current place, focus and secondary actions. It never signals live.

rules.name: The Lime Is Air Time Rule
rules.body: Lime means only a LIVE pip ("On now") and the one primary action on a screen. At most one lime button per screen; many screens (Home, Dashboard, Settings, Admins) have none. Lime is never a decoration, a heading colour or a hover.

rules.name: The Words Carry State Rule
rules.body: Every status bug says its state in words ("On now", "Upcoming", "Finished", "Dates TBC", "Published", "Draft", "Active", "Disabled"). Colour and the pip only reinforce them.

rules.name: The Two Widths Rule
rules.body: Condensed caps (width 75% to 85%) are for plates, names, labels, buttons and nav. Reading text (body, ledes, meta, inputs, notices) stays at normal width and sentence case.

rules.name: The Brand Casing Rule
rules.body: "iTala" keeps its own casing inside capitalised plates ("SIGN IN TO iTala CONNECT"); it is never set as "ITALA".

rules.name: The Platform Tabular Rule
rules.body: The platform body sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, so every date and count lines up.

rules.name: The Three Steps Rule
rules.body: Ground, plate, raised plate. A new surface takes the next step up from what it sits on; it never gets a shadow.

rules.name: The Own Ground Rule
rules.body: The iTala mark ships on its own #0B0F18 ground and is placed directly on Network Ground, where the two are the same colour. Do not doctor the artwork, recolour it, or sit it on a plate where its ground would show as a square.

rules.name: The One Cut Rule
rules.body: Every plate has exactly one diagonal, on the right end (or the bottom-right corner for panels). Never a left cut, a double cut, or a rounded corner.

rules.name: The Inside Focus Rule
rules.body: A clipped plate would cut off an outside focus ring, so focusable plates (event bugs) draw the 3 px teal ring inside (-3px offset).

rules.name: The Red Is Words Rule
rules.body: A destructive action outside a dialog is Alert Red underlined text, never a filled plate.

rules.name: The Safe Choice First Rule
rules.body: In a confirmation dialog Cancel comes first and takes focus; the go-ahead is teal and names the act. A confirm is never lime.

dos: Do keep the worlds apart: --ev-* and division tokens inside event pages, --brand-* on platform screens, and never one in the other.
Do write dates as DD/MM/YYYY and times as "7:00 pm", in NZ English, with "-" as the only dash.
Do keep touch targets at least 2.75rem, make wide grids and tables scroll inside themselves, and check the layout at 360 px.
Do read every colour on an event page from --ev-*, --div or --on-div, deriving tints with color-mix(in srgb, ... , var(--ev-bg)).
Do draw structure with 2 px paint lines and separate sections with space.
Do pair every state with words and a stroke pattern: solid on court, dashed up next, baseline tick for final.
Do use Big Shoulders for numerals and headings, the stencil cut for court numbers only, Archivo for names and body, all with tabular numerals for scores and times.
Do put lettering that crosses court lines on a Floor Tint patch.
Do check a new surface against a second organiser palette, including a light floor, before calling it done.
Do open every platform page with a title plate (teal key, plate, sub-strip) as its h1.
Do keep teal for identity and plate edges, and lime for the LIVE pip and at most one primary action per screen.
Do cut plates on one right-end diagonal (0.9rem) and panels on the bottom-right corner (1.25rem).
Do stack surfaces ground, plate, raised plate, with 1 px seams where a line is needed.
Do set plates, names, labels, buttons and nav in condensed Saira caps, and reading text at normal width.
Do say every status in words on its bug; colour only reinforces it.
Do keep "iTala" in its own casing inside capitalised plates.
Do place the iTala mark directly on Network Ground, unaltered.
Do keep every link and button in an action row at least 2.75rem tall, wrapping rather than truncating.
Do ask through the confirmation dialog, Cancel first, before an event, team or division is removed or unsaved edits are lost.
Do repeat every chosen calendar date as a removable chip beneath the calendar.
donts: Don't add shadows, glows, gradients, blurs, glass or textures in either world.
Don't use --brand-* tokens, iTala logo colours or hard-coded hex values inside an event page; the only iTala element is the "Powered by iTala Connect" footer, painted in event tokens.
Don't add wood grain or other court costume.
Don't put games or sections in filled cards or panels; a game is an outline on the floor.
Don't add another moving mark beyond the now line and the score paint-in.
Don't show a game clock, period or quarter; the mobile app owns those.
Don't round corners beyond 2px, except the circles a court actually has.
Don't use lime for headings, decoration, hovers or a second button on the same screen.
Don't build white cards, a left sidebar, or rounded corners; the only circle is the LIVE pip.
Don't add motion beyond the one-time title plate wipe, the LIVE pip and 150ms colour transitions.
Don't describe or treat the iTala mark as transparent, or recolour, crop or re-ground it.
Don't apply the iTala mobile app's colour-role rule here; it was declared not binding on 26/09/2026.
Don't put a destructive action on a filled plate, or make a dialog's go-ahead lime.
Don't use the browser's native confirm prompt for in-app questions; the only native prompt left is the reload and close-tab fallback.

Tall condensed athletic lettering (Big Shoulders) for numerals and headings, stencil cut for court numbers, Archivo for names and body.
One moving mark (the "now" line) plus a brief paint-in when a score changes.
Network ground platform-ground, plates on two navy steps, 1 px seams.
Angled plates with one diagonal cut on the right end; panels cut on the bottom-right corner; no rounded corners.
Teal is identity and plate edges; lime is only LIVE and the one primary action.
Saira throughout: condensed caps (width 75% to 85%) on plates, normal width for reading, tabular figures everywhere.
One signature motion (the title plate wipe) and one repeating motion (the LIVE pip).
